entities.summary: Erik Thomas Shoji is an American professional volleyball player who plays as a libero for Asseco Resovia and the U.S. national team. Shoji was a bronze medalist at the Olympic Games Rio 2016, Paris 2024 and the 2018 World Championship; the 2014 World League and 2015 World Cup winner, and a two–time Champions League winner with ZAKSA.
